scripts.build: bun run --filter @better-typescript/core build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/rules build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/cli build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p examples/programmatic/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test --timeout 30000 tests/*.test.ts packages/rules/src/rules/*/test/*.test.ts
